title: source-map: a chunked map of one source's teachable content
description: One file per source, stored under source-kb/source-maps/ (SMAP-1, docs/project/open-decisions.md, 20 September 2026 — landed under this fallback id after the ruling's own stated id SM-1 collided with a pre-existing 16 July 2026 summative-page ruling). Core fields (any kind): chunk id, locator, exact heading, shape ids each with a quote, boundary note, status. A benchmark-kind map (BM-1) adds three extra layers: blockType (a closed 15-value list), pathwayTags with strength and evidence, and orientation. Gates read maps, never the source's own PDF (BM-1's last sentence) — this file's chunks are the only grounding a gate may cite.

sourceId.description: Matches an entry id in source-kb/source-kb.json (schemas/source-kb.schema.json's own id pattern, reused here so the two stores stay mechanically joinable).

kind.description: book: a source map under SMAP-1's core fields only. benchmark: a source map with BM-1's extra layers (blockType, pathwayTags, orientation) available on its chunks, and chunks that follow QAA's numbered paragraphs rather than book headings.

orientation.description: BM-1's whole-map orientation layer: the benchmark's own framing/aims section, summarised in prose. Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map, which carries no equivalent framing layer under SMAP-1.

textPointer.description: Points at a gitignored companion full-text file (source-kb/source-maps/_text/) when the source's full text is not otherwise readable from a repo-tracked working copy (e.g. a benchmark extracted from a PDF). Omit when the source-kb entry's own locator.repoPath already gives a readable working copy (e.g. the book).

file.description: Repo-relative path, always under the gitignored _text/ companion directory.

chunks.description: Zero chunks is a FAIL (validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps), never a vacuous pass.

id.description: Unique within this file. Book convention used by the Chapter 10 pilot: '<chapter-slug>/<section-slug>', e.g. ch10/defining-academic-integrity. A benchmark chunk id may instead follow QAA's own numbered-paragraph scheme (BM-1), e.g. '3.1-3.4', which the pattern also admits via dot-separated numeric segments.

heading.description: The exact heading text as it appears in the source (book) or the numbered-paragraph label (benchmark). Checked verbatim against the source's text by validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps.

locator.description: Where this chunk sits in the source. At least one of pages or paragraphs must be given when the source carries that kind of marker; noMarkers states plainly that none exist rather than the field being silently absent.

pages.description: Page range as marked in the source text, e.g. '185-187'.

paragraphs.description: QAA numbered-paragraph range, benchmark-kind chunks (BM-1), e.g. '3.1-3.4'.

noMarkers.description: States plainly that no page or paragraph markers exist in the source for this chunk, and why.

shapes.description: One or more content shapes this chunk exhibits, each with a quote of at most two sentences (SMAP-1).

shapeId.description: Must resolve in design-kb/design-kb.content-shapes.json (checked by validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps).

quote.description: At most two sentences, quoted verbatim from the source, evidencing this shape.

pathwayTags.description: Which of the 13 pathways this chunk grounds, each with an evidence quote. Available on any kind of map (the Chapter 10 pilot uses this on a book-kind map); strength is a benchmark-only refinement (BM-1's 'pathway tags with strength').

pathway.description: A catalogue/context/pathways.json pathway id. Not enumerated here (SMAP-1 AMENDMENT, Prompt 143, 21 September 2026): a fixed copy of the id list drifted out of step with the catalogue silently, with nothing checking the two against each other. validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps checks this value against catalogue/context/pathways.json directly instead.

evidence.description: A quote or stated reason grounding this pathway tag. Never left blank (checked by validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps).

strength.description: BM-1's benchmark-only strength layer, e.g. explicit/implicit. Omit on a book-kind map.

blockType.description: BM-1's 15-value block-type list. Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map.

boundaryNote.description: Recorded where a shape (or, for a benchmark chunk, a block type) is ambiguous between two reasonable choices, stating the choice made and why.

status.description: Every map is confirmed chunk by chunk by Abbott (SMAP-1); a newly authored chunk is always 'proposed' until that confirmation lands.

sectionKind.description: SMAP-1 AMENDMENT (21 September 2026, Prompt 141): teaching, the default when this field is absent, keeps SMAP-1's full requirement of at least one shape. framing marks a chunk with no teaching content of its own (a chapter's opening, its learning-objectives-and-keywords section, or its summary) and may hold no shapes.

orientation.description: BM-1 AMENDMENT (21 September 2026, Prompt 148): this chunk's own orientation category (e.g. academic, professional), copied verbatim from QAAVector. Distinct from the map's whole-map orientation field above, which is a different, coarser layer (BM-1's original framing/aims summary). Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map.

orientationEvidence.description: BM-1 AMENDMENT (21 September 2026, Prompt 148): the evidence quote grounding this chunk's orientation value, copied verbatim from QAAVector. Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map.

excluded.description: BM-1 AMENDMENT (21 September 2026, Prompt 148): true when this chunk is front matter, furniture or otherwise carries no teachable content. An excluded chunk is recorded (per BM-1 AMENDMENT) rather than omitted, but carries no blockType, pathwayTags, orientation or shapes. Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map.

excludedReason.description: BM-1 AMENDMENT (21 September 2026, Prompt 148): why this chunk is excluded, copied verbatim from QAAVector. Non-empty whenever excluded is true (checked by validate-design-schemas.py --source-maps, not schema alone). Benchmark-kind only — forbidden on a book-kind map.

allOf.description: SMAP-1's original shapes-required rule (else branch, unchanged) now has three exemptions: a framing chunk (Prompt 141, book-kind), a chunk carrying blockType (Prompt 148: only a benchmark-kind chunk can carry blockType, so its presence is a reliable benchmark signal at this chunk-only scope), or a chunk marked excluded (Prompt 148: an excluded benchmark chunk needs no shapes either).
